description: This PHP source file defines a class called TerminationReasonMenuConfigurator within the namespace OrangeHRM\Pim\Menu. The class implements the MenuConfigurator interface and uses the ModuleScreenHelperTrait. Its primary function is to configure a menu related to termination reasons within the OrangeHRM system, specifically overriding the current screen with 'viewTerminationReasons.'

classes.name: TerminationReasonMenuConfigurator
classes.description: Class implements menu configuration for termination reasons, overriding the current screen to 'viewTerminationReasons'. It utilizes traits and interfaces to integrate with the OrangeHRM system's menu architecture.
